newsitem.title: USA: Oryx sees Q4 operating income, cash flow rising.
newsitem.headline: Oryx sees Q4 operating income, cash flow rising.

text.p: Oryx Energy Co said Wednesday that net income from operations for the fourth quarter should increase five times over the prior year to the $50 million range, compared to $10 million in the year-ago quarter.
The company said it expects discretionary cash flow to increase about 50 percent to about $165 million, compared to $111 million.
The company attributed the strong performance to higher prices and higher production volumes.
"We're having execellent business results this quarter, which will cap a very good year," said Edward Moneypenny, chief financial officer of the Dallas-based oil and gas company.
